note: Architecture rules as data. `checker` names a function in devx/lib/arch/checkers.mjs; `params` tune it. severity error: any finding fails unless grandfathered in devx/arch.baseline.json; ratchet: the baseline holds the current level and it may only go down. Add a rule here and name an existing checker: no code edit.

rules.description: kits, rigs and style reference nothing outside themselves (KIT.md); packs, seeds and good examples use only public TL classes, never class_name, never StandardMaterial3D/lights/environments (mirrors lint.gd bypass 'style')
every engine class_name follows the prefix allocation (contracts/README.md, KIT-RIG-STYLE.md): TL for the kernel, TLKit/TLMesh in kits, TLRig in rigs, TLStyle in style; no duplicates
every .gd.uid has its .gd and every .gd has its .gd.uid
verbs.json agrees with host.gd OPTIONS/LEVELS, contracts/RUNNER.md and the tl.sh usage header
every tl.<name>/<n> schema string used in engine/, foreman/src and contracts/ is declared in a contracts/ doc
no tracked .gd/.ts/.mjs file over 600 lines; files already over are held at their baseline size (may shrink, never grow)
.claude/sessions.json scopes do not overlap between sessions (absent file passes)
docs/generated/API-INDEX.md equals what `tl arch --index` generates from the GDScript sources

docs/generated/API-V1.json is the kernel API contract: a class, method, signal, property or constant in it may not be removed or changed without a new major version (KERNEL_API in manifest.gd), and an addition needs a new minor; the finding names the member
